$comment: YouTube Data API quota for automatic posting (D375; PT2 D408). Two models. 'upload-bucket' (the default since PT2): videos.insert has its own daily bucket (uploadBucketPerDay calls a day, not taken from quotaUnitsPerDay); each upload still costs thumbnailUnits from the unit quota. Uploads a day that fit = min(uploadBucketPerDay, floor((quotaUnitsPerDay - readReserveUnits) / (thumbnailUnits + read units))), and never more than maxUploadsPerDay (100, YouTube's own upload limit; the grid-tiers placement can fill that many). Read units (D434): one complete channel read is reused for upload sessions while it is younger than readReuseMinutes (data/posting/schedule.json; 0 = read before every session, the D409 rule), so a day pays at most min(uploads, ceil(1440 / readReuseMinutes)) reads of 1 + 2 x maxPages units each (401 at 200 pages): fit = the most uploads n with n x thumbnailUnits + reads(n) x 401 <= quotaUnitsPerDay - readReserveUnits. 'unit-sum' (the old D375 model, the fallback): each upload costs insertUnits + thumbnailUnits (+ the read units) from the unit quota: floor((10000 - 100) / 1731) = 5. When YouTube answers an upload with quotaExceeded while the bucket model is in use, nothing uploads until the next Pacific midnight (exhaustedUntil), the day's earlier bucket uploads are recounted at insertUnits each, and the app counts the 'unit-sum' way for the rest of that Pacific day and fallbackDays more (a repeated answer never extends this), says so in plain words (task bar and Settings), and tries the bucket model again after (state in <data dir>/posting/quota-model.json). quotaUnitsPerDay is the project's daily quota in Google Cloud Console (APIs & Services > YouTube Data API v3 > Quotas); the user's own value lives in <data dir>/posting/schedule.json. Reads: channels.list, playlistItems.list and videos.list cost 1 unit each. Read by services/posting/quota-budget.mjs; never hardcoded.
captionUnitsSource: captions.insert 400 units, needs youtube.force-ssl: https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/docs/captions/insert (checked 2026-11-24). C1: one call per long highlights upload, reserved like an upload (never from readReserveUnits); a missing or bad value skips the caption track, never the video.
source: quotaUnitsPerDay 10000 (default allocation), thumbnailUnits 50, read calls 1 unit, and videos.insert in its own bucket of 100 calls a day: https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/determine_quota_cost (fetched 2026-11-13; the bucket is UNVERIFIED for this project until a day with more than 6 uploads goes through). model upload-bucket as the default with the quotaExceeded fallback: user 2026-11-21 ('youtube permits upto 100 uploads a day'; plan docs/plan/2026-11-21-posting-text-schedule-growth.md PT2). insertUnits 1600 (fallback model only): docs/plan/2026-11-03-p16b-youtube-private-upload-plan.md. readReserveUnits 100, fallbackDays 1: agent, not a user instruction. maxUploadsPerDay 100: user 2026-11-22 (D434: "YouTube allows me to upload 100 videos/reels a day - that's the max"); read by services/posting/auto-post.mjs (MAX_PER_DAY), was 24 (D408).
